name: OmaOpus
author: MaenExists
description: Lightning-fast, ultra-lightweight YouTube music player for Omarchy OS. Stream any track in under a second with background pre-caching, cosmic aurora visualizer, seamless queue autoplay, persistent favorites, and a sleek top bar widget that runs under 15MB RAM.

barWidget.description: Instant YouTube music streaming, smart queue autoplay, and favorites directly from your top bar with <15MB RAM footprint.
